rolereach.label: How far this role sees
rolereach.owner: The Owner always sees the whole company.

hint.own: People with this role see only work they are part of — what they do, gave, verify or started.
hint.branches: People with this role see the work of the branches they work at or manage, plus anything that has no branch.
hint.entity: People with this role see every branch of their legal entity.
hint.group: People with this role see every branch. Choose "Their branches" for staff who should only see their own branch.
